mapper.insert: insert into cart( user_id, total_quantity, selected_count, total_price ) values( #{cart.userId}, #{cart.totalQuantity}, #{cart.selectedCount}, #{cart.totalPrice} ) on duplicate key update total_quantity = #{cart.totalQuantity}, selected_count = #{cart.selectedCount}, total_price = #{cart.totalPrice}, id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.delete: delete cart, cart_item from cart left join cart_item on cart.id = cart_item.cart_id where cart.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select c.id as id, c.total_quantity as total_quantity, c. total_price as total_price, i.sku_id as sku_id, i.quantity as quantity from cart as c left join cart_item as i on c.id = i.cart_id where c.user_id = #{userId}
